findings.message: Root composition is missing `data-composition-id`.
findings.fixHint: Add a stable `data-composition-id` to the entry composition wrapper.

findings.message: Root composition is missing `data-width` or `data-height`.
findings.fixHint: Set numeric `data-width` and `data-height` on the entry composition root.

findings.message: Missing `window.__timelines` registration.
findings.fixHint: Register each composition timeline on `window.__timelines[compositionId]`.

findings.message: CSS declaration `transition: color 0.15s ease` runs on the browser clock and cannot be seeked deterministically across render workers.
findings.fixHint: Keep the class or attribute swap for state; put the visual change on the paused GSAP timeline.

findings.message: <div class="noise-section-label" data-start="10.0"> has no id, so Studio cannot use a stable edit target for its timeline and canvas controls.
findings.fixHint: Add a stable, human-readable id such as id="hero-title" or id="scene-1-card" to every timeline-visible element you want agents or Studio to edit.

findings.message: This HTML composition file has 327 lines. Smaller sub-compositions are easier to read, iterate on, and diff.
findings.fixHint: Split coherent scenes or layers into separate .html files under compositions/, then mount them from the parent with data-composition-src so each file stays small enough to inspect, revise, and validate independently.

findings.message: <meta> has timing attributes but no class="clip". The runtime still hides it outside its time range, but Studio and the GSAP clip-ownership rules use .clip to recognise a clip, so leaving it off makes the element harder to edit and to lint.
findings.fixHint: Add class="clip" to the element so Studio and the linter can recognise it as a clip.

findings.message: `requestAnimationFrame` runs on wall-clock time, not the GSAP timeline. It will not sync with frame capture and may cause flickering or missed frames during rendering.
findings.fixHint: Use GSAP tweens or onUpdate callbacks instead of requestAnimationFrame for animation logic.
